description: Manual trigger and gate from one large button

params.text: Sends a 1ms trigger as it goes down and holds the gate at 10V until it is let go; with the hold latched, pressing it drops the gate instead
Latches the gate at 10V, and unlatches it when pressed again

inputs.text: A trigger here latches or unlatches the gate
A gate here works the large button, raising the gate output for as long as it is high

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse each time the gate output rises
10V while the gate is on, and 0V otherwise

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
